rationale: With AIR 1's scan complete, I am deploying our final reserve drone D3 to survey the unscanned FiDi URM-infill block at One Sansome Street. This densely populated block holds roughly 9,000 occupants and carries a 65% predicted collapse risk, offering the highest life-saving information per minute. No drones remain in reserve after this final wave.

missions.purpose: Survey unscanned URM-infill block at One Sansome Street for predicted collapses and trapped occupants.
